finding.description: The viable first manifest is reuse-first: two current neutral busts and current choice art, three approved 408x560 expression variants, one 1280x720 background, and one conditional Cut-In. Smoke/VFX is not yet justified and should not reserve an asset or ID.
finding.recommendation: Freeze one core manifest with expression assets VN046-POR-01..03 and background VN046-BG-01; retain VN046-CUT-01 only if approved; exclude VN046-VFX-01 from this delivery.
finding.gate: Human approval of the three expressions, background direction and Cut-In verdict before any asset request.

finding.description: The contracts agree on 408x560 RGBA expression canvases and 1280x720 background/Cut-In exports. Estimated decoded scene textures are approximately 5.564 MiB without the Cut-In and 9.080 MiB with one Cut-In, excluding engine/UI textures, cache retention and swap overlap.
finding.recommendation: Preload only the final scene set, replace rather than stack expression textures, retain at most one Cut-In, and recompute the final simultaneous set after the manifest freezes.
finding.gate: Asset-intake dimension/alpha checks plus Playtest/profiling on target hardware before memory, load hitch or frame pacing is declared valid.

finding.description: ContadorHistoria_* versus Reed/Rheed_VN046_* and VN046/* versus parallaxes/CutIns are incompatible request contracts; issuing both would create duplicates or broken references.
finding.recommendation: Preserve existing Reed final.png and CriancaOrc_.png. After the Reed/Rheed gate, select exactly one storyteller family; use Portraits/Principal for variants, frontend/img/parallaxes/VN046_NoiteHistoria_BG.png for the background, and frontend/img/pictures/CutIns/VN046_ThorinIntroducao_CutIn.png only if approved.
finding.gate: Resolve Reed/Rheed, confirm directories and freeze one exact-case filename per approved asset before user delivery.

finding.description: The consistent stack is parallax background below bust IDs 1-2, plugin-managed UI without an assigned ID, and a provisional transient Cut-In at ID 10. The technical POV's TA-V05 incorrectly requests Cut-In absence before code 404 even though B10 occurs after that reconvergence.
finding.recommendation: Do not reserve IDs 3-4. Inventory picture ownership before freezing ID 10; enter the Cut-In only at B10, erase it after B10 and before B11, then assert absence again before COMPLETE_VN and FinishVisualNovel.
finding.gate: Implementation-time picture ownership review, structured cleanup validator and Playtest of z-order/residual pictures in both branches.

finding.description: The completed reviews reconcile the reusable choice files as InnButton_01 normal at 388x101 and InnButton_00 hover at 392x104. No new choice art is needed, but plugin-managed draw order, hit area and cleanup are not established by PNG metadata.
finding.recommendation: Carry only exact paths and resolved dimensions into the final manifest; assign no Picture ID and make no visual-state change in this phase.
finding.gate: Playtest normal, hover, input, branch selection and cleanup at 1280x720.

finding.description: Asset and staging feasibility depends on unresolved Reed/Rheed naming, Confirmar semantics, switches 43/44, canonical Thorin reference and potion/smoke approval. Visual implementation cannot safely absorb or conceal those decisions.
finding.recommendation: Preserve all switch 43/44 operations by default; keep the Cut-In and expression staging conditional; keep literal mountain imagery and smoke outside approved art until their respective gates close.
finding.gate: Human decisions on identity, branch consequence, Thorin art direction and staging, followed by technical diagnosis of switches 43/44 before implementation changes.

completion_record.validators: XML parse; agentic_agent_review schema v1; six findings; locators, severity, recommendation and gate present in every finding; no upstream or runtime write.
